scenes.text: Watch and read: For your characters practice, read: “Ama found a red ball at the playground. Ama gave it back to Kojo. The day ended happily.” Who is the main character?
The answer is: Ama. The character is the person the story is about.
Watch and read: Ama asks: Read: “First Ama found a lost pencil. Next Ama asked for help. Finally Ama returned the pencil to the teacher.” What happened finally?
The answer is: returned the pencil to the teacher. Look for the last event when retelling in order.
